name: Birds Canada Community Grant
summary: One-year grants from Birds Canada, funded by its Birdathon, for community-led projects that help conserve birds, including actions that protect birds and their habitats. Priority goes to local groups with limited access to other funding.

calls.label: Annual September call
calls.recurring: Applications accepted each September, due September 29 at 5:00 PM Pacific Time, for projects in the following calendar year.

status.quote: Applications are accepted annually in September for projects taking place the following calendar year.

recurring.quote: Submit your application online by September 29th at 5:00 PM Pacific Time in either English or French.
